% Units as the PDF sets them: nicefrac's and xfrac's fractions with a
% slash (MathJax has neither), and siunitx's numbers, units, and quantities
% in text, in math, and in a display (MathJax has none of siunitx's
% commands).
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{nicefrac}
\usepackage{xfrac}
% siunitx.4ht loads color, which tex4ht then does not configure (see
% test-units-nocolor). xcolor in the preamble keeps the colors.
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{siunitx}
\DeclareSIUnit\pct{\%}
\begin{document}
Half of $\nicefrac{1}{2}$ is $\sfrac{1}{4}$, and $\nicefrac[\mathrm]{a}{b}$.

Text: \num{12345.678}, \num{1.5e-3}, \SI{3}{\meter\per\second},
\qty{9.81}{\metre\per\square\second}, \si{\kilo\gram}, \unit{\joule},
\ang{30}, \numrange{1}{5}, \qtyrange{1}{5}{\kelvin}, \numlist{1;2;3},
\qtylist{1;2}{\metre}, \qty{2}{\percent},
{\sisetup{mode=text}\qty{1.5}{\metre}}, \qty{3}{\pct}.

Math: $v = \SI{3}{\meter\per\second}$, $\qty[per-mode=fraction]{9.81}{\metre\per\square\second}$,
$\num{1.5e-3} + \unit{\joule}$, $\ang{30}$.
\begin{align}
  E &= \qty{1.6e-19}{\joule}
\end{align}
\end{document}
